## Why This Is Asked
Tests for offline sync and conflict resolution are common in fintech and media apps; this checks practical thinking beyond basic unit tests.

## Key Concepts
- Offline storage (IndexedDB)
- Sync strategies (last-write-wins, timestamps)
- Conflict resolution determinism
- End-to-end tooling (MSW, Playwright)
- CI simulation of offline/online

## Code Example
```javascript
function resolveConflict(local, remote) {
  // last-write-wins by timestamp
  if ((local.updatedAt || 0) > (remote.updatedAt || 0)) return local;
  return remote;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test idempotency in syncing?
- How would you handle large sync payloads and partial failures?

## Why This Is Asked

This question probes end-to-end testing strategy for ML-driven real-time features at scale, including data drift, canary safety, and latency guarantees, which are critical for large-scale services.

## Key Concepts

- Data drift detection (PSI, KS)
- Shadow/canary testing
- End-to-end latency budgets
- Synthetic data generation and replay
- Rollback criteria and alerting

## Code Example

```javascript
function psi(expected, actual) {
  // placeholder drift calculation
  return Math.abs(expected - actual) / Math.max(1, Math.abs(expected));
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle cold-start users in canaries?
- How would you validate drift thresholds across regions?
